description:
Log in to Bahmni (User: superman, Pass: Admin123). Go to the 'Clinical' app and search for patient 'Priya Patel' (ID: BAH000005). Start a consultation/open the patient dashboard.

In the 'Diagnoses' section, record the following two diagnoses:
1. 'Malaria' -> Set Order to 'Primary' and Certainty to 'Confirmed'.
2. 'Anaemia' -> Set Order to 'Secondary' and Certainty to 'Confirmed'.

Save the consultation. Ensure both diagnoses are successfully added to the patient's record.
